'''The son of Falner Oeth''' - a member of the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] - was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who served in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial military]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], he was hoping to join the elite [[Shadow Fist]] commando unit.
